purpose: Matched utility comparison of released English and multilingual GLiNER decision checkpoints against frozen Qwen and Decider results.
inference: Original FP32 weights, native eager fallback, flashdeberta disabled, independent records with native schema rendering. Tez render_state supplies the original state. No context truncation. Preserve exact instructions, option keys, descriptions and order. Read-only classifier hook recovers all logits; verify full softmax against every native answer/confidence.
batch_smoke: Before any benchmark case, repeat the four frozen non-benchmark probe inputs in batches. Require identical native labels and maximum probability change <= 0.00001. No threshold relaxation.
evaluation: All 6151 primary decisions in 21 original public tasks, plus 1100 reversed-option MASSIVE decisions. T=1 raw accuracy, ECE15, NLL, Brier, macro-F1, typed soft accuracy, official SemIf evaluator. No calibration fit, task routing, prompt selection, label-dependent configuration, or training.
scope: These already-observed public tasks are exploratory regression comparisons, not fresh confirmation. Released competitor training membership is unknown; comparisons do not isolate architecture effects. GPU elapsed time includes model setup and thermal pauses and is not a valid latency result.
compute: Local laptop only, one arm at a time through C:/temp/run_heavy.py, four threads, unchanged thermal rules. Thirty-minute worker cap including setup, with 29-minute checkpoints. No cloud spending.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve raw partial rows/logs if input audit, smoke parity, memory, thermal or time limits fail. A partial result does not count as a completed benchmark. Do not silently truncate or change precision.
promotion: No runtime promotion. Existing quality, calibration, option-order, probability-parity and target-laptop latency gates remain unchanged.
amendment: Both first attempts terminated during the four-case non-benchmark smoke, before any public prediction. Processor._collate_batch natively appends a period to non-punctuated text. The audit now accepts only that exact transformation, then checks every native word and label. The processor error policy is raise rather than fallback to prevent dummy records. No model weights, prompt, precision, batch, tolerance or benchmark membership changed.
